players.product: AI data-center colocation (Tydal, Norway: 121 IT MW leased to Volta for NVIDIA GPUs) and Bitdeer AI GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 / Vera Rubin capacity in Malaysia, Norway and the US)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 interim results (first statements under U.S. GAAP): total net revenues US$417.7 million vs US$225.7 million in H1 2025. AI cloud services revenue increased by 557.3% to US$17.7 million from US$2.7 million, primarily due to increased GPU equipment deployed and scaling into AI cloud service contracts. AI Cloud is now a separate reportable segment: H1 2026 segment net revenues US$17,689 thousand, segment cost of revenues US$24,988 thousand (depreciation US$7,036 thousand) and segment gross loss US$7,299 thousand (H1 2025: gross loss US$2,268 thousand).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue US$417.7 million; AI cloud US$17.7 million (+557.3%); AI Cloud segment gross loss US$7,299 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue concentration (customers not named): Customer B 51.61% and Customer C 10.44% of net revenues (H1 2025: Customer A 14.52%, Customer C 10.81%).

Build-out commitments (H1 2026 interim statements): capital commitments, primarily for construction of datacenters, contracted but not yet recognized were US$154.8 million at June 30, 2026 vs US$65.3 million at December 31, 2025; commitments scheduled to be paid within 12 months for property, plant and equipment and intangible assets were approximately US$252.6 million. H1 2026 purchases of property, plant and equipment and intangibles were US$359.7 million (H1 2025: US$157.2 million), covering SEALMINER production, datacenter infrastructure construction, GPU equipment procurement and tariffs and freight; GPU equipment at cost US$49,549 thousand vs US$13,656 thousand. In March 2026 subsidiary Tydal Data Center AS signed an open-book, cost-plus design and construction contract with Data Center Installations AS to convert the Tydal, Norway datacenter into an AI datacenter, to be completed in phases commencing in December 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: capital commitments US$154.8 million (vs US$65.3 million); US$252.6 million due within 12 months; H1 2026 PP&E purchases US$359.7 million
